cases.obligation: The Engine Accessibility preflight supplies no options dictionary and therefore cannot request a trust prompt.
The actual Event Tap callback returns a real self-tagged CGEvent without queueing it and normalizes a real foreign-tagged CGEvent into the queue.
The actual Event Tap callback only enqueues foreign input; the shared production run-loop drain leaf later invokes the context and action consumer from that same TapState queue.
The context wake capacity is one and multiple pending observations coalesce to the latest complete request.
The request cadence seam accepts button-down immediately, rate-limits only mouse movement, and rejects button-up, wheel, and other events.
The private AX query seam applies the 50 ms timeout before exact AXFocusedWindow and AXTitle reads in focused-title-refocused order.
The production worker invalidates a prior successful context when resolution returns Accessibility permission denial.
The production worker invalidates a prior successful context when resolution returns a non-timeout Accessibility error.
The production worker invalidates a prior successful context when resolution returns the AX cannot-complete timeout class.
The production worker invalidates a prior successful context when resolution returns target exit or invalid process identity.
A nullable CF Create or Copy result is rejected before an owned reference can run CFRelease.
An oversized context string is rejected before snapshot publication.
A malformed context string is rejected before snapshot publication.
A reused PID with a different process start identity replaces the prior cached window and target token.
A focused-window change during title resolution is rejected instead of publishing a mixed window context.
The CFHash window fingerprint is not treated as a unique target identity.
A cached context is usable only at its exact sampled point and through the fixed freshness boundary.
Resolution that exceeds the cache freshness budget is discarded and invalidates prior context.
macOS compilation selects ordered Shared and Macos records, matches bundle identity case-insensitively, and retains the macOS command binding.
macOS process matching derives the complete bounded executable basename instead of the truncated process comm name.
The resolver worker stops within its bounded wait and invalidates its latest snapshot.
Worker readiness is published before capability FFI so startup readiness cannot wait on a hung preflight.
Shutdown during a blocked capability preflight returns without joining, invalidates immediately, and releases worker resources after the preflight returns.
The existing serialized ForegroundWindowInfo contract remains the three Windows fields and gains no macOS bundle field.
